type Triangle

    procedure :: init => triangle_init

    procedure :: print => triangle_print

is a one-component type whose only field is
of that element type. A triangle contains three pointers to points allocated somewhere else. That is composition: the triangle is built out of another type, and it does not inherit from that type.

subroutine triangle_init(this)

    class(Triangle) :: this
    class(Point), pointer :: p_point

    integer :: i

    do i=1,3
        allocate(p_point)
        call p_point % init(0.0, 0.0)
        this % m_points(i) % p_element => p_point
    end do

end subroutine
